kurz: A pressure cooker holds the steam in. Under pressure the water gets about 120 °C hot, and everything cooks much faster.
bild_im_kopf: Like a shortcut over the mountain: the same route, but much less time.
faustregeln: About a third of the normal cooking time, as a guide.
Pulses and grains foam: fill only halfway.
schritte: Add at least the stated amount of liquid; fill no more than two thirds.
Close the lid and heat on high until it shows pressure.
Turn the heat down so the pressure just holds; count the cooking time from now.
Let the pressure drop or release it as instructed, and only then open.
